definitions.gloss: to stand in a row; to be lined up (of buildings, structures)
definitions.explanation: Used to describe buildings, houses, or structures standing side by side along a street or in an area. Evokes a visual image of a row of structures.

examples.japanese: ⟦ビル→ビル：01500_biru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{建|た}ち{並|なら}ぶ。
⟦{通|とお}り→通り：01475_toori⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{沿|そ}って→沿う：13279_sou⟧⟦お{店|みせ}→お店：21164_omise⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{建|た}ち{並|なら}んで⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。

⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{高層|こうそう}→高層：04145_kousou⟧⟦マンション→マンション：01035_manshon⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{建|た}ち{並|なら}び、⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{面影|おもかげ}→面影：06631_omokage⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: High-rise apartments line the area in front of the station, and there's no trace of what it used to look like.

notes:
A compound verb of ⟦{建|た}つ→建つ：12544_tatsu⟧ (to be built, to stand) and ⟦{並|なら}ぶ→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧ (to line up). Specifically used for buildings and structures, not for people standing in a line. Common in descriptions of cityscapes, neighborhoods, and street scenes.

TRANSITIVITY:
Intransitive — the buildings are the subject.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦ビル→ビル：01500_biru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{建|た}ち{並|なら}ぶ — buildings line up
- ⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{建|た}ち{並|なら}ぶ — houses stand in a row
- {建|た}ち{並|なら}ぶ⟦{商店街|しょうてんがい}→商店街：09391_shoutengai⟧ — a shopping street lined with stores

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{並|なら}ぶ→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧ — to line up (general, not specific to buildings)
- {立|た}ち{並|なら}ぶ — to stand in a row (for people or trees; uses ⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧ not ⟦{建|た}つ→建つ：12544_tatsu⟧)
- ⟦{軒|のき}→軒：03912_noki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{連|つら}ねる→連ねる：02080_tsuraneru⟧ — to stand side by side (literary, for buildings)
